en.text: Which of the following statements about inflation is/are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪(幾)項有關通脹的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) only

zh.text: 只有 (1)

en.text: (2) only

zh.text: 只有 (2)

en.text: (3) only

zh.text: 只有 (3)

en.text: Inflation occurs when the government handouts a large sum of cash to every citizen in a certain year.

zh.text: 當政府在某一年向每位市民派發一大筆現金，通脹便會出現。

en.text: Inflation redistributes wealth from lenders to debtors if it is anticipated.

zh.text: 若通脹是預期的，通脹會令財富再分配，由貸款人轉至債務人。

en.text: People prefer holding real assets to cash under expected inflation.

zh.text: 在預期通脹的情況下，人們偏好持有實質資產而非現金。
